orgName: Riyadh Season boxing cards (General Entertainment Authority)

source.name: UFC.com (archived) - Canelo Alvarez to face Terence Crawford in blockbuster Riyadh Season showdown
source.note: 'HE Turki Alalshik, Chairman of the General Entertainment Authority and President of the Saudi Boxing Federation, today confirmed the blockbuster Riyadh Season showdown' (Canelo-Crawford, Las Vegas, 13 Sep 2025, Netflix), with 'Alalshikh and his Riyadh Season team' collaborating with Dana White and Sela.

note: Event host/title and funder. Riyadh Season (GEA) cards include Ring IV: Benavidez-Yarde (22 Nov 2025, anb Arena Riyadh), Ring V: Inoue-Picasso (27 Dec 2025, Mohammed Abdo Arena, per Inoue's Wikipedia fight record; a Ring page dates it 27 Nov - conflict noted), and Canelo Alvarez vs. Christian Mbilli (moved to 31 Oct 2026, Riyadh; ESPN, 23 Jul 2026). Host fees not published.
